text:
priya: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4921 needs 1 more approval + CI green. tiny rename + fmt. PTAL @sarah @michael

michael: glanced — logic looks fine. one small naming nit: prefer `kv_cache` over `kvStore` to match package conventions. also add a line in changelog?

sarah: i'm on a call, can take a look in ~30m. if it's just a rename + `gofmt` i'm fine with a quick squash and merge.

alex: pushed a cleanup branch with the `kv_cache` rename and ran `gofmt -w .` locally. force-pushed -> CI triggered.

ci-bot: build/ci #4921 — started (unit tests, lint)

priya: thanks alex. i also removed a flaky test (seed nondeterminism) and noted it in the PR description.

michael: another tiny nit: exported name `GetKV` might be visible externally. If this is internal-only, make it unexported to avoid API churn.

alex: good catch — changed to `getKVCache` (unexported), force-pushed again.

ci-bot: build/ci #4921 — all checks passed ✅

sarah: reviewed & approved :thumbsup:

priya: awesome. who can take a merge spot? queue is busy today. prefer to merge during the low-traffic window.

alex: i can merge in ~10min. holding for any objections. will pick a low-traffic slot and kick the canary.

michael: fine by me, go ahead after the 10min hold.

priya: added a short changelog line about the rename + flaky test fix.

alex: merged, started deploy canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for runtime v0.21.3 — monitors: latency/runtime, error-rate.

priya: watching dashboards now — initial canary metrics look good, no latency spike. closing the loop, thanks everyone :tada:
